Alambadi.description: Hardy draught breed, grey/dark grey coat with backward-curving horns.
Alambadi.hallmarks: Narrow face, backward horns curving slightly inward, active temperament.

Amritmahal.description: Fierce, athletic draught breed developed for historical cavalry transport.
Amritmahal.hallmarks: Long sharp horns pointing backwards and ending in sharp points, grey to white coat.

Ayrshire.description: Medium-sized dairy cattle with distinctive red-and-white or mahogany patches.
Ayrshire.hallmarks: Even red-brown and white coloration, lyre-shaped horns or polled, balanced dairy udder.

Banni.description: Resilient, heat-tolerant buffalo adapted to harsh arid climates; nocturnal grazer.
Banni.hallmarks: Medium to large body, coiled vertical ring horns, exceptionally high milk fat content.

Bargur.description: Known for endurance and speed in hilly terrain.
Bargur.hallmarks: Brown coat with distinct white patches, long horns pointing backward and upward.

Bhadawari.origin: Uttar Pradesh & Madhya Pradesh (Chambal ravine tract)
Bhadawari.description: Renowned for the highest fat percentage in milk among buffalo breeds (up to 13%).
Bhadawari.hallmarks: Copper or light yellowish-brown skin color (copper-colored), two white lines (chevron) under the neck (Janeu).

Brown_Swiss.description: Large dairy cattle breed noted for docility and high protein milk yield.
Brown_Swiss.hallmarks: Solid brown/grey coat with light muzzle ring and dark nose.

Dangi.description: Exceptional working ability under heavy rainfall and muddy paddy fields.
Dangi.hallmarks: Distinctive speckled coat (red-white or black-white speckles), oily skin secretion.

Deoni.description: Gentle dual-purpose breed popular across the Deccan plateau.
Deoni.hallmarks: White coat with irregular black or red patches, drooping ears, convex forehead.

Gir.description: World-famous indigenous milch breed, known for A2 milk and heat tolerance.
Gir.hallmarks: Prominently convex forehead, long pendulous leaf-like curled ears, half-moon horns.

Guernsey.description: Dairy breed producing golden-tinted milk rich in beta-carotene.
Guernsey.hallmarks: Fawn/golden coat with white markings, gentle disposition.

Hallikar.description: Premier draught breed of South India, known for unmatched stamina.
Hallikar.hallmarks: Long, backward sweeping horns with sharp tips, lean and energetic build.

Hariana.description: Robust white/grey dual-purpose animal popular in North Indian agriculture.
Hariana.hallmarks: White to light grey coat, narrow face with flat forehead, short horns curved inward.

Holstein_Friesian.hallmarks: Distinctive large black and white piebald patches, large stature, well-developed udder.

Jaffrabadi.description: One of the heaviest riverine buffalo breeds with enormous body frame.
Jaffrabadi.hallmarks: Prominent heavy drooping horns (drooping headgear), wide bulging forehead.

Jersey.description: Popular small dairy cattle breed with high butterfat content.
Jersey.hallmarks: Fawn to light brown body, dished face with large dark eyes, black muzzle with white ring.

Kangayam.description: Sturdy, prized draught breed celebrated in traditional rural culture.
Kangayam.hallmarks: Compact body, short stout legs, strong upward curved horns, grey/white coat with dark extremities.

Kankrej.description: Majestic indigenous breed celebrated for the graceful Sawai Chaal gait.
Kankrej.hallmarks: Massive lyre-shaped horns, pendulous ears, strong hump and dark dewlap shading.

Kasargod.description: Miniature indigenous cow adapted to tropical humid climates with high disease resistance.
Kasargod.hallmarks: Compact miniature stature, varied coat colors (often brown/black), docile.

Kenkatha.description: Hardy draught breed thriving on scrub vegetation and hilly terrain.
Kenkatha.hallmarks: Small to medium size, grey/roan coat, horns projecting forward.

Kherigarh.description: Active draught animals capable of pulling heavy loads in alluvial soils.
Kherigarh.hallmarks: White coat, long upturned horns, narrow muzzle.

Khillari.description: Fast-trotting, powerful draught breed closely related to Hallikar.
Khillari.hallmarks: Long upward swept horns, pinkish nose and eyelids, tight skin and grey-white color.

Krishna_Valley.description: Massive draught cattle bred for heavy agricultural tillage in deep black cotton soil.
Krishna_Valley.hallmarks: Heavy massive build, grey-white body with darker quarters in bulls, short horns.

Malnad_gidda.description: Dwarf hill cattle breed with high disease resistance and adaptation to heavy monsoons.
Malnad_gidda.hallmarks: Miniature height (under 95 cm), black or brown solid colors, active foragers.

Mehsana.description: High yielding cross derivative of Murrah and Surti buffaloes.
Mehsana.hallmarks: Semi-sickle/curled horns less tightly coiled than Murrah, heavy milk production.

Murrah.description: The Black Gold of India — premier dairy buffalo breed worldwide.
Murrah.hallmarks: Jet black coat, tightly curled spiral horns, short broad neck, soft skin.

Nagori.description: One of the most famous fast-trotting draught breeds in India.
Nagori.hallmarks: Tall stature, long thin legs, white/light grey coat, flat forehead.

Nagpuri.description: Lighter river buffalo well-suited for draught and dairy in hot central India.
Nagpuri.hallmarks: Long flat sword-shaped horns curving backward towards shoulders, black coat.

Nili_Ravi.description: Distinctive dairy buffalo known as the Panch Kalyan.
Nili_Ravi.hallmarks: Five white marks: forehead blazes, muzzle, 4 white socks, and white switch on tail.

Nimari.description: Draught breed created from crossing Gir and Khillari stocks.
Nimari.hallmarks: Red coat with irregular white splashes (piebald), moderately long backward horns.

Ongole.description: World-renowned majestic Zebu breed; foundation of the international Brahman breed.
Ongole.hallmarks: Massive frame, large hump in bulls, short stumpy horns, pure white/light grey color.

Pulikulam.description: Agile and fiery native cattle commonly used in traditional Jallikattu events.
Pulikulam.hallmarks: Small compact body, dark grey coat with black hump and tail tip, forward-curving sharp horns.

Rathi.description: Renowned dairy breed of the Thar desert, highly efficient food converter.
Rathi.hallmarks: Brownish coat with white patches or solid dull brown, docile, medium horns.

Red_Dane.description: Robust European dairy breed with high milk production and longevity.
Red_Dane.hallmarks: Solid dark red coat, robust frame, calm temperament.

Red_Sindhi.description: Famous heat-resistant dairy cattle known for rich milk yield.
Red_Sindhi.hallmarks: Rich deep red coat, compact well-proportioned body, thick short horns.

Sahiwal.description: Premier indigenous milch breed; highest milk producer among native Indian cattle.
Sahiwal.hallmarks: Reddish-dun coat, loose skin with prominent pendulous dewlap (Lola), stumpy horns.

Surti.description: Medium-sized docile buffalo renowned for economical milk production.
Surti.hallmarks: Sickle-shaped horns curving downward then upward, two white collars around throat.

Tharparkar.description: White Sindhi cattle with exceptional desert hardiness and disease resistance.
Tharparkar.hallmarks: Lyre-shaped horns, pure white or light grey coat reflecting desert heat, convex forehead.

Toda.description: Unique hill buffalo bred exclusively by the indigenous Toda pastoral tribe.
Toda.hallmarks: Wide crescent-shaped horns curving outwards and upwards, fawn to ash-grey coat, thick hair coat.

Umblachery.description: Compact draught breed specially suited for marshy delta paddy cultivation.
Umblachery.hallmarks: Calves born red/brown turning grey, white star on forehead, short backward curved horns.

Vechur.description: The smallest cattle breed in the world (Guinness Record), famous for medicinal milk properties.
Vechur.hallmarks: Extremely small size (avg height ~85-90 cm), low maintenance, high resistance to mastitis.
